name: Pushdown equivalence must dominate semantic recheck elision

payload.contract: Successful serialization or pushability proves capability, not semantic equivalence; skipping a second semantic owner requires an execution differential over the admitted type domain.
search_shape: a producer converts a predicate or expression for a remote engine
a boolean such as pushed/encoded/supported disables local scalar recheck
the remote result directly controls a durable artifact or wrong-result fast path
admission_gate: name the remote and local semantic owners
construct a root-only equivalent reference that cannot be partially pushed
lift only a RED cell to the highest durable or rowset consumer
payload.negative_gate: when all currently admitted expression classes are GREEN, retire instead of enumerating more literals
